definition: The Buddhist six realms of samsara: Deva, Human, Asura, Animal, Preta, and Hell. All beings flow with karma; the Journey to the West world is built on this, but 'immortal-and-Buddha retinues' and 'those who attain the true fruit through the pilgrimage' can leap beyond samsara
core_principle: Among the six realms, Deva and Human are good, Asura is half-good, and Animal, Preta, and Hell are the three evil realms. Karma determines one's destination, while cultivation can transcend it

realms.name: Deva Realm
realms.population: The gods and Buddhas of heaven, countless devas
realms.entry_criteria: Highest-grade ten good deeds, or complete cultivation, or the return of an orthodox deity to position
realms.exit_criteria: Falls when blessings are exhausted, or flows with karma when heavenly lifespan ends
realms.duration: One or more kalpas — extremely long
realms.characteristics: Devas enjoy great blessings, but are still within samsara — not final liberation

realms.name: Human Realm
realms.population: The beings of the mortal world — humans across the four great continents
realms.entry_criteria: Middle-grade good deeds, keeping the five precepts, or rebirth after a deva's blessings are exhausted
realms.exit_criteria: Flows with karma, reborn according to karma, or transcends through cultivation
realms.duration: A single life of several decades to a century — brief
realms.characteristics: The human realm is half joy and half suffering, easiest for cultivation, and a necessary condition for Buddhahood

realms.name: Asura Realm
realms.population: The asuras, with heavenly fortune but not heavenly virtue
realms.entry_criteria: Good deeds tainted by anger, or cultivation with success but an untamed temper
realms.exit_criteria: Anger turned to good can ascend to heaven; heavy anger falls to the evil realms
notable_cases: Great Peng Golden-Winged Roc (retinue of the Peacock Bodhisattva, Buddha-mother)
realms.characteristics: Asuras are warlike, always contending with heaven — a realm of fortune without virtue

realms.name: Animal Realm
realms.population: Birds, beasts, water-creatures, insects, and all manner of demons
realms.entry_criteria: Low-grade evil deeds, ignorance, lust breeding retribution for lust, or negligence drawing heavy punishment
realms.exit_criteria: Reborn when karma is exhausted, or recruited and reformed
realms.duration: Indefinite, according to the length of karma
notable_cases: Zhu Bajie wrongly cast into a sow's womb
Sha Wujing, river ogre of the Flowing Sands
Jing River Dragon King's karmic flow
realms.characteristics: The animal realm is ignorant and often driven — a good place for atonement

realms.name: Preta Realm
realms.population: The pretas, with huge bellies and thin throats, always tormented by hunger and thirst
realms.entry_criteria: Middle-grade evil deeds, greed and stinginess, or heavy greed in life
realms.exit_criteria: Reborn when karma is exhausted, or delivered through rites
realms.duration: Long, always tormented by hunger and thirst
notable_cases: After Meng Po's soup, past lives forgotten; lonely ghosts on the Yellow Springs road
realms.characteristics: The preta realm is greedy and stingy, always craving and never obtaining — the fruit of greed

realms.name: Hell Realm
realms.population: Suffering beings, tormented according to the severity of their sins
realms.entry_criteria: Highest-grade evil deeds, the five gravest offenses and ten evils, or grave breaches of heavenly law
realms.exit_criteria: Released when karma is exhausted, or delivered by Kṣitigarbha Bodhisattva
realms.duration: Long — measured in kalpas, the longest
notable_cases: mountain of knives and sea of fire
realms.characteristics: The hell realm is the most bitter, released only when karma is exhausted — the ultimate fruit of evil karma

escape_paths: Attained the true fruit through pilgrimage
samsara_stats.common_pattern: 4 of the 5 pilgrims were originally heavenly deities demoted to the mortal world (animal realm / water ogre); ultimately all transcended samsara

samsara_insights: The pilgrimage team is the special case of 'leaping beyond samsara'; all 5 ultimately became Buddhas or attained the true fruit, transcending the six realms
The animal realm is a good place for atonement; Bajie, Wujing, and the White Dragon Horse all transcended via the animal realm
The human realm is the best place for cultivation; Tang Sanzang lived 10 lives in the human realm before becoming a Buddha
The Deva realm is not final; when devas' blessings are exhausted they still fall, and must cultivate to transcend
The Asura realm is a realm of 'fortune without virtue,' corresponding to some demon lineages
The Preta and Hell realms are the ultimate fruit of evil karma, but one may leave when karma is exhausted — not eternal punishment
